notes_for_editor: Very thin. Sources: the Forest Lookouts listing (patrol lookout, St. Joe National Forest, 47N-1W-24), PeakVisor (elevation 5,646 ft / 1,721 m), and one firelookout.com line about patrol points. That line spells the peak 'Rockat Peak' and places it 2.5 miles north of St. Joe Baldy. The story raises the match with the Forest Lookouts spelling as an inference that neither source states, and cites the two sources only for the two spellings and the patrol point. Record coordinates (47.39992, -116.40933) are within about 50 m of PeakVisor (47.399711, -116.40995). Record agency and county agree with the listing. Rochat Peak does not appear in the FFLA Benewah County list either; noted for the editor only. No structure, build date, staffing or fire history found in cache or two searches. The record's ownership 'federal' is consistent with the national forest but no source states it, so it is not a fact here.
